[P2] Scope fault-release ordering to the selected cleanup and recovery

This maximum includes task exits from healthy peers and unrelated attempts. For example, victim exit at 35, recovery at 45, fault release at 50, and peer exit at 100 satisfies the observation checks but fails final validation here. The fault was released after the asserted recovery, and the peer remained occupied through recovery, so its later exit should not invalidate the measurement. Select the victim's cleanup boundary and the selected recovery request's recovery boundary instead of every matching event, and cover this ordering in a regression test.
